name: Stillpoint — Neural Meditation & Cognitive Wellness Centers
description: Stillpoint centers offer BCI-assisted meditative sessions calibrated to individual neural profiles, guiding users through structured attentional training, trauma-signal dampening, and deep rest states unavailable through unaided sleep in a high-stimulation urban environment. Practitioners argue Stillpoint is not escapism but cognitive maintenance — the neural equivalent of physical therapy in a city that runs its residents at continuous high load. Flagship centers in Tier 4 offer bespoke 'cognitive architecture' sessions co-designed with licensed neurotechnicians.
story_hooks: A character undergoing Stillpoint sessions begins experiencing memories during meditation that don't belong to them — and the memories appear to be from someone currently in danger.
An investigator discovers that a specific Stillpoint center is being used to quietly deliver behavioral modification signals to a subset of clients who have no idea their sessions have been altered.

A Stillpoint neurotechnician goes off-grid after discovering what the Axiom data pipeline is actually being used for — and leaves behind a set of session logs that constitute a significant evidence trail.
